The IS 350 F SPORT stands as a striking expression of athletic design, its bold spindle grille, sculpted bodywork, and aggressive stance complemented by the deep Caviar exterior finish. Equipped with 19-inch F SPORT Alloy Wheels, Triple-Beam LED Headlamps, F SPORT Exterior Styling, and a Power Moonroof, this sedan projects confidence from every angle. This 2018 Lexus LS 500 Base represents a premium sedan that combines sophisticated engineering with refined luxury appointments. Finished in Black, this locally-owned, one-owner vehicle has been meticulously maintained and arrives at our dealership ready for discerning drivers who appreciate quality craftsmanship and advanced comfort technology.

- AWD with 3.5L V6 engine and 10-speed automatic transmission
- 20" Vapor Chrome Split 10-spoke alloy wheels with performance tires
- Panoramic glass roof and sunroof
- Mark Levinson 23-speaker, 2400-watt surround sound system
- Navigation system with panoramic view backup monitor
- 24" heads-up display
- Lexus Safety System+ with advanced package and pre-crash system
- LED headlamps with adaptive front lighting
- Adaptive variable air suspension with rapid height function
- Luxury Package including heated and cooled front seats with memory
- Heated rear seats with rear seat air conditioner
- Power rear seat adjuster with rear power headrest and memory
- Heated wood and leather-trimmed steering wheel
- Premium semi-aniline leather interior with ultra suede headliner

This LS 500 delivers 18 city and 27 highway miles per gallon, offering respectable efficiency for a vehicle of its caliber. The adaptive variable air suspension dynamically adjusts to road conditions, providing a smooth, composed ride whether navigating city streets or highway corridors. The cabin showcases premium wood trim throughout, complemented by genuine leather appointments that create an atmosphere of understated elegance.

The technological suite is comprehensive and intuitive. The heads-up display projects essential driving information directly into your line of sight, reducing the need to glance away from the road. Navigation is seamlessly integrated, while the Mark Levinson audio system transforms every drive into a concert experience with its 2400-watt output and 23-speaker configuration. Climate control is individually customizable, with heated and cooled front seats, heated rear seats, and a dedicated rear seat air conditioner ensuring passenger comfort regardless of season.

Safety has been engineered throughout this vehicle's design. The Lexus Safety System+ Advanced Package includes pre-crash technology and traffic sign recognition, actively monitoring the road ahead. Dual front and side impact airbags, knee airbags, and rear side airbags create a comprehensive protective envelope. The panoramic view backup monitor provides enhanced visibility during reversing maneuvers, while speed-sensing steering and electronic stability control work continuously to support confident vehicle handling.

Rear passengers enjoy amenities typically reserved for executive-class vehicles. The power rear seat adjuster allows fine-tuning of recline angle and legroom, while the rear power headrest with memory settings supports personalized comfort. Power rear side sun shades and a power rear sunshade provide privacy and climate control, transforming the back seat into a sanctuary for relaxation or work.

This LS 500 is presented in exceptional condition with a clean title and no complications. It represents an opportunity to own a luxury sedan with a proven track record of reliability, advanced technology, and genuine premium comfort. We invite you to schedule a test drive and experience firsthand the refinement and capability this vehicle delivers.

Interior appointments reflect F SPORT exclusivity with heated and ventilated front seats finished in perforated NuLuxe material, contrasted by the leather steering wheel and leather shift knob. Climate control features include front dual-zone air conditioning, heated door mirrors, and a rear window defroster ?'all contributing to year-round comfort. The cabin remains connected through the 8-inch multimedia touchscreen with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility, complemented by a premium 10-speaker audio system. Safety and driver assistance systems are comprehensively equipped with Active Cruise Control, Electronic Stability Control, four-wheel independent suspension, and speed-sensing steering that adjusts responsiveness based on vehicle velocity. The exterior parking camera provides rearward visibility, while auto High-beam Headlights with front fog lights enhance nighttime visibility. Dual front and side airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags combine with a security system to prioritize occupant protection. This 2024 Lexus IS 350 F SPORT presents an opportunity to own a Japanese sports sedan that balances performance ambition with refined everyday usability, backed by proven mechanical architecture and Lexus's commitment to quality.

This 2020 BMW 7 Series 740i combines luxury and performance in a refined package that commands attention on the road and delivers excellence in every detail.

The powertrain features a 3.0L I6 DOHC 24V TwinPower Turbo engine paired with an 8-Speed Automatic transmission and rear-wheel drive, delivering 22 city MPG and 29 highway MPG. This efficient performance makes the 740i an excellent choice for drivers who value both power and fuel economy.

The M Sport Package elevates this sedan with distinctive styling, including M door sills, M foot rest, and an aerodynamic kit that enhances both appearance and performance. The 20-inch M Orbit Grey wheels wrapped in performance run-flat tires stand as a testament to the vehicle's dynamic character, supported by an increased top speed limiter for enhanced driving capability.

Inside, the cabin showcases authentic craftsmanship with Fineline Black Wood trim, genuine wood console, dashboard, and door panel inserts. The Dakota Leather upholstery pairs with front ventilated seats and heated front seats with multi-contour support, while the M Sport steering wheel puts control at your fingertips. Climate control is comprehensive, featuring front and rear dual-zone automatic temperature control with rear air conditioning.

Advanced technology includes a Navigation System, Apple CarPlay compatibility, and a Harman/Kardon Surround Sound System with 16 speakers and SiriusXM Satellite Radio. Safety features encompass a comprehensive airbag system, electronic stability control, adaptive suspension, and BMW Assist eCall emergency communication.

The exterior presents itself in elegant Black with Shadowline exterior trim, auto-dimming door mirrors with heating, and fully automatic headlights with delay-off function. A power moonroof and rear window blind complete the premium presentation.

With 46,029 miles, this 740i represents an outstanding opportunity to own a luxury sedan that has been maintained and is ready for its next chapter with an appreciative owner.

  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.

The 2.0L I4 DOHC engine paired with an eCVT transmission provides smooth, responsive acceleration while maintaining exceptional economy. The interior presents a driver-focused environment designed for comfort and convenience. Heated front bucket seats with power adjustment keep you comfortable in any season, while the leather-wrapped steering wheel and shift knob add a touch of premium feel. Safety features reflect Honda's commitment to protection, including dual front and side airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags throughout the cabin. The Lane Keeping Assist System actively helps maintain your position in the lane, while the Blind Spot Information System provides visibility alerts. Electronic Stability Control, traction control, and four-wheel disc ABS brakes work together to help you maintain control on any road surface.

The exterior combines style with function—body-color bumpers, a rear spoiler, and auto high-beam headlights with delay-off capability showcase thoughtful design. Power door mirrors with heating add both convenience and safety, while speed-sensitive variable intermittent wipers adapt to changing weather conditions.

This 2025 Accord Hybrid Sport offers a complete package for the discerning driver who values efficiency, reliability, and refined everyday performance.

This 2021 Tesla Model 3 Performance represents an opportunity to own a sophisticated electric vehicle that combines advanced technology with practical daily performance.

- 15 Speakers with Premium Audio System
- All-Wheel Drive with 1-Speed Automatic transmission
- Navigation System with Exterior Parking Camera
- Premium Heated Front Bucket Seats with memory function
- Heated steering wheel and heated rear seats
- Fully automatic headlights with auto-dimming capability
- Front dual zone automatic temperature control
- Lane Departure Warning System
- Electronic Stability Control and traction control
- Four-wheel independent suspension with speed-sensing steering
- 20" Uberturbine alloy wheels
- Dual front impact and side impact airbags with knee airbag protection
- Auto-dimming rear-view mirror with compass
- Telescoping and tilt steering wheel with memory
- Security system with low tire pressure warning

The Model 3 Performance delivers an EPA-estimated 118 MPGe in city driving and 107 MPGe on the highway, offering efficient electric operation suited for both urban commuting and longer trips. With all-wheel drive and a responsive suspension system, this vehicle maintains stability across various driving conditions. The white exterior presents a clean, modern appearance that complements the car's contemporary design.

The interior environment prioritizes comfort and convenience. Premium heated front bucket seats with power adjustment and memory settings ensure your driving position can be personalized and recalled. The dual-zone climate control system allows independent temperature management for driver and passenger, while heated rear seats extend comfort to all occupants. The heated steering wheel adds an additional layer of comfort during colder months.

Technology integration throughout the cabin supports both safety and usability. The premium 15-speaker audio system pairs with the navigation system to create an engaging driving experience. Steering wheel-mounted controls for audio and climate functions minimize distraction, while the trip computer provides driving data at a glance. The auto-dimming rear-view mirror and fully automatic headlights with delay-off functionality contribute to convenience and safety.

Safety features throughout the vehicle provide multiple layers of protection. The lane departure warning system alerts you to unintended lane movement, while electronic stability control and traction control work together to maintain vehicle control. Four-wheel independent suspension combined with speed-sensing steering enhances handling response. The comprehensive airbag system includes dual front impact, dual front side impact, knee, and overhead units positioned throughout the cabin.

The exterior combines functionality with distinctive styling. The 20-inch Uberturbine wheels provide both visual appeal and sturdy performance. Auto-dimming door mirrors with heating functionality reduce glare and improve visibility in varying weather conditions. Front fog lights enhance visibility in challenging conditions, while the spoiler contributes to aerodynamic efficiency. The exterior parking camera offers added confidence when reversing.

This 2021 Model 3 Performance is ready for your test drive and evaluation. Contact us to schedule a viewing and experience this vehicle firsthand.

The Charger R/T combines classic muscle car DNA with contemporary comfort and technology. The interior offers generous amenities including HomeLink garage door control, an overhead console for convenient storage, and a leather steering wheel with audio controls.

This well-maintained sedan presents an excellent opportunity to own a refined Acura with the technology features you expect. Visit us today to experience the TLX Technology Package firsthand.

Intuitive Park Assist with auto braking takes the stress from tight spaces, while rear cross-traffic braking protects you in parking lot situations. This 2022 Audi A8 L 55 quattro represents an exceptional choice for those seeking refined luxury and sophisticated performance in a full-size sedan.

- Audi Adaptive Cruise Assist with Lane Guidance
- Audi Side Assist
- Heated Steering Wheel
- Intersection Assist
- Traffic Sign Recognition
- 20" 10-Parallel-Spoke-Design Wheels
- 22-Way Heated Multi-Contour Comfort Front Seats
- Audi MMI Navigation Plus
- Bang & Olufsen Sound System with 3D Sound
- Power 2nd-Row Moonroof
- Contour/Ambient LED Interior Lighting Package
- Executive Package
- Ventilated Front Seats
- Valetta Leather Seat Upholstery
- Front Dual Zone Automatic Temperature Control

The A8 L delivers a commanding presence on the road with its striking black exterior and precision engineering. Its 3.0L turbocharged V6 engine produces 335 horsepower and pairs with an eight-speed automatic transmission featuring Tiptronic manual shift capability. The quattro all-wheel-drive system ensures confident traction and handling across various driving conditions.

Inside, the cabin showcases meticulous attention to detail with Valetta leather seating that includes 22-way power adjustment with heating and ventilation capabilities. The front seats offer individual heating and cooling functions for personalized comfort. An extensive suite of comfort features includes an auto-dimming rear-view mirror, power-adjustable front head restraints, and comprehensive dual-zone climate control throughout the cabin.

Advanced driver assistance technology enhances every journey. The system monitors traffic signs and recognizes them through Traffic Sign Recognition, while Intersection Assist provides additional confidence at complex intersections. Adaptive Cruise Assist manages speed and distance while Lane Guidance helps maintain proper positioning, supported by Side Assist monitoring.

The Audi MMI Navigation Plus system provides seamless route planning and real-time information. Smartphone integration through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto allows easy connection to your mobile device. The premium Bang & Olufsen sound system with 3D sound delivers exceptional audio clarity through seventeen speakers, while SiriusXM satellite radio offers unlimited entertainment options.

Exterior refinements include LED fog lights complementing the auto high-beam headlights, heated power mirrors with turn signal indicators, and rain-sensing wipers that automatically adjust to conditions. The power moonroof adds an open-air dimension to the driving experience, while the 20-inch ten-parallel-spoke wheels showcase both style and substance.

This A8 L combines luxury, technology, and performance into a cohesive driving experience designed for discerning owners. We invite you to visit and experience this exceptional sedan firsthand.

Discover the refined efficiency and sophisticated comfort of this 2022 Lexus ES 300h, a sedan that seamlessly blends fuel economy with premium appointments.

- 2.5L I4 hybrid engine delivering 43 city and 44 highway MPG
- Premium Package with heated and ventilated leather seats
- 12.3" navigation touchscreen with Lexus Enform services
- Heated leather steering wheel with power tilt/telescoping adjustment and memory
- Power moonroof
- 18" split-10-spoke alloy wheels with 2-tone dark machined finish
- Wireless charging pad
- Rain sensing wipers and windshield deicer
- Exterior parking camera
- Electrochromatic auto-dimming rearview mirror
- Power-folding outside mirrors with memory
- Wood trim interior accents
- Remote keyless entry with key card
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility

With an EPA-estimated 43 miles per gallon in the city and 44 on the highway, this ES 300h reduces your fuel stops without sacrificing capability. The continuously variable transmission works seamlessly with the gas engine to optimize efficiency across all driving conditions.

Step inside to experience purposeful luxury. The interior showcases wood trim detailing that establishes an atmosphere of understated elegance. Front heated and ventilated seats adjust to your preference through multiple power settings, with the driver's seat featuring full memory functions. The heated leather steering wheel responds to climate and provides intuitive control through integrated audio buttons.

Navigation is handled by Lexus's 12.3-inch multimedia display, which integrates with your smartphone through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto. The system includes Lexus Enform Dynamic Navigation for three years and Dynamic Voice Command available for up to ten years, keeping you connected and informed throughout your ownership. SiriusXM radio with a CD player and ten speakers delivers your favorite entertainment with clarity.

This four-door sedan prioritizes your safety with dual front impact airbags, side-impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags. Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS and traction control work in concert with the four-wheel independent suspension to deliver confident handling. Electronic stability control and speed-sensing steering further enhance your command of the road.

The 2022 ES 300h represents a thoughtful automotive purchase for buyers seeking reliability, efficiency, and refined capability in a midsize sedan.

        • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.

Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.
        • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
        Technology and Telematics
        • Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicle's infotainment system. Smart device mirroring brings together safety and convenience by making it easier to find what you're looking for while keeping your eyes on the road.

- Intuitive Park Assist with Rear Cross-Traffic Braking
- Heated and Ventilated Front Seats
- Power Tilt and Slide Moonroof
- Heated Leather Trim Steering Wheel
- Auto-Dimming Rearview Mirror with HomeLink System
- Rain-Sensing Intermittent Windshield Wipers
- Multimedia System with 8-inch Color Touchscreen
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto Integration
- 10 Premium Speakers with SiriusXM
- Front Fog Lights with Auto High-Beam Headlights
- 18-inch Alloy Wheels
- Illuminated Door Sills

- Comfort Package

The IS 300 achieves 21 mpg in the city and 31 mpg on the highway, making it efficient enough for daily commuting while maintaining the performance characteristics Lexus owners expect. With 32,592 miles, this vehicle represents a carefully maintained example of the breed.

The interior showcases premium Perforated NuLuxe seat trim complemented by heated and ventilated front seating that adapts to seasonal comfort demands. The power-adjustable driver and passenger seats provide personalized positioning, while the split-folding rear seat accommodates both passengers and cargo flexibility. Climate control features include automatic temperature management with front dual-zone air conditioning and rear window defroster functionality for year-round comfort.

Technology and convenience features work seamlessly throughout the cabin. The multimedia touchscreen integrates Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, allowing you to connect your smartphone effortlessly. Steering-wheel-mounted audio controls keep essential functions within reach, while the trip computer and outside temperature display provide useful driving information at a glance.

As a Lexus L/Certified vehicle, this IS 300 includes:
- Roadside Assistance
- Warranty Deductible: $0
- Vehicle History
- CERTIFIED WARRANTY: Comprehensive Inspection, Unlimited-mileage warranty up to 6 years. Balance of new car warranty (4 Year/50K Miles) plus 2 Year/Unlimited-mileage L/Certified warranty. 10-year/150,000-mile Hybrid Battery Warranty

The comprehensive airbag system includes dual front impact, dual front side impact, knee, and rear side impact airbags alongside overhead protection. Lexus Safety Connect provides emergency communication capabilities for added peace of mind on the road.

This 2023 IS 300 L/CERTIFIED stands ready to deliver the balanced performance and refined comfort you deserve. Contact us today to schedule your test drive and experience this premium sedan firsthand.

The premium leather interior welcomes you with heated and cooled front seats, a heated steering wheel, and climate-controlled seating that adjusts to your preferences. Intelligent Cruise Control with full speed range and hold adapts to traffic conditions, while the automatic emergency braking system with pedestrian detection provides an additional layer of protection. Lane departure warning and blind spot detection keep you aware of your surroundings, and rear cross-traffic collision-avoidance assist helps prevent accidents when backing up. The rear backup camera displays clearly on your dashboard for confident parking.

This Maxima Platinum is Nissan-certified, meaning it has undergone a comprehensive multi-point inspection to ensure it meets Nissan's rigorous quality standards. You can drive with confidence knowing this vehicle has been thoroughly evaluated and approved by factory-trained technicians.

Every detail speaks to thoughtful engineering, from the rain-sensing wipers that automatically adjust to weather conditions to the easy-access HomeLink garage door transmitter. Introducing this 2023 Cadillac CT5 Luxury, a sophisticated sedan that combines refined engineering with practical everyday functionality for the discerning driver.

This Luxury model comes equipped with an impressive collection of features designed to enhance your driving experience:

- All-Wheel Drive for confident handling in varied conditions
- 2.0L Turbocharged engine delivering responsive performance
- Navigation with embedded Cadillac User Experience system
- Bose Premium Audio Package with 15 speakers
- UltraView dual pane sunroof for natural light and openness
- Heated driver and front passenger seats
- Heated steering wheel
- Leather steering wheel with mounted audio controls
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration
- Automatic temperature control with front dual zone A/C
- All-weather floor mats and cargo mat

The interior presents a welcoming environment with Inteluxe seating surfaces, power-adjustable front bucket seats with lumbar support, and a power rear window defroster. The cabin features dual-zone automatic climate control, allowing both driver and passenger to set preferred temperatures independently. Three USB ports keep your devices charged during commutes or longer journeys.

Safety remains a priority with this CT5, featuring dual front impact airbags, front and rear side impact airbags, knee airbags, and an overhead airbag system. Additional safety technologies include brake assist, traction control, and OnStar emergency communication capabilities. The sedan also offers a rear anti-roll bar and front anti-roll bar for improved stability.

Efficiency comes naturally with the 2.0L turbocharged engine paired to a 10-speed automatic transmission, achieving an EPA-estimated 23 city and 33 highway miles per gallon. The vehicle sits on 18-inch alloy wheels with a bright silver finish, complemented by the striking Blue Wave Metallic exterior color.
